name: text-area
description: A multi-line text input for free text such as a bio, a comment or a message, with its label, optional description and validation error. It grows with its text. Enter adds a line; ⌘/Ctrl+Enter submits the surrounding form. For a single line use text-field. Compose the parts you need inside TextArea: TextAreaLabel, TextAreaInput, TextAreaDescription and TextAreaError (renders only while the value is invalid), all exported from the text-area file.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value on every edit.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Requires a value before the form submits.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Prevents editing and dims the field.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the value invalid from outside, e.g. after a server error.

props.name: validate
props.type: (value: string) => string | string[] | true | null | undefined
props.description: Returns an error message for an invalid value, shown by TextAreaError.

props.name: validationBehavior
props.description: native validates on form submit; aria validates as the user types.

example:
<TextArea name="bio">
  <TextAreaLabel>Bio</TextAreaLabel>
  <TextAreaInput placeholder="A line or two about you" />
  <TextAreaDescription>Shown on your profile.</TextAreaDescription>
  <TextAreaError />
</TextArea>
